# fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1 (Data Source)

Retrieve information about a managed FKE cluster. Attribute names follow the `fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1" "example" {
  vpc_id       = "your_vpc_id"
  cluster_name = "my-cluster-ab12cd34" # the full name, as fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engines_v1 reports it
}

output "k8s_version" {
  value = data.fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1.example.k8s_version
}

# Names of the pools that have a GPU
output "gpu_pools" {
  value = [for pool in data.fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1.example.pools : pool.name if pool.vgpu_id != ""]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The full name of the cluster, e.g. `my-cluster-ab12cd34`, as `id` and `cluster_name` of `fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engines_v1` report it.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC the cluster belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_endpoint_access` (Object) Access to the Kubernetes API server: `type` (`public`, `private` or `mixed`) and the allowed CIDR blocks in `allow_cidr`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_endpoint_access))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) The full name of the cluster, the same as `cluster_name`.
- `is_running` (Boolean) `false` when the cluster is hibernated.
- `k8s_max_pod` (Number) Max pods per node
- `k8s_version` (String) Kubernetes version
- `network_type` (String) Network plugin, e.g. `calico` or `cilium`.
- `node_network` (String) Node network (address)
- `node_prefix` (String) Node network (prefix)
- `pod_network` (String) Pod network (address)
- `pod_prefix` (String) Pod network (prefix)
- `pools` (List of Object) The worker pools of the cluster, each with `name`, `worker_type` (flavor ID), `machine_type` (flavor name, e.g. `2C4G`), `vgpu_id` (empty for a pool without GPU), `storage_profile`, `worker_disk_size` (GB), `scale_min`, `scale_max`, `worker_base`, `is_enable_auto_repair`, `network_id`, `pool_tags` (the tag IDs of the pool, inherited cluster tags included), `driver_installation_type`, `gpu_driver_version`, `max_client` and `gpu_sharing_client`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))
- `purpose` (String) Cluster purpose: `public`, `private` or `firewall`.
- `service_network` (String) Service network (address)
- `service_prefix` (String) Service network (prefix)
- `tags` (Set of String) The tag IDs of the cluster.
